hints.tr: İşin içinde `needs: build`, `runs-on`, ve `permissions:` altında `contents: write`.
hints.en: Inside the job: `needs: build`, `runs-on`, and `contents: write` under `permissions:`.
Since the code is not fetched, `--repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY"` is required; `GH_TOKEN` under `env:`.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

**.github/workflows/ci.yml**

```yaml
name: Release

on:
  push:
    tags: ["v*"]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.13"
      - run: pip install -r requirements.txt
      - run: python -m pytest
  build:
    needs: test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.13"
      - run: python scripts/check_version.py "$GITHUB_REF_NAME"
      - run: python -m pip install build
      - run: python -m build
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: dist
          path: dist/
  release:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: dist
          path: dist
      - run: |
          gh release create "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" dist/* \
            --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --generate-notes
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
